body:
Okay...
So I was blowing up the iron with tnt to make a BIG stash of iron armor for my team.
As I was collecting, a staff member kicked me for team griefing.
It was obvious that I wasn't trying to ruin the game.

title: Abuse? (Idk if this is in the wrong spot...)

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Destroying any kind of team supply with TNT is detrimental and causes more harm than in any case good. Your iron supply is not intended to be exploded regardless, as it's a team utility, and furthermore using TNT against blocks removes more than half of the supply which hurts your team more.

Due to the high blast resistance as well, I assume it was determined to be reckless.

replies.author: Cynthesis
replies.body:
Using TNT in that way is very ineffective, wasteful, and harmful. As a result, you were kicked. As Para mentioned above, there's no good reason to do that in substitution for using a pickaxe.

Also, are you attempting to appeal this kick? Because the "Appeal an Infraction" topic is predominantly used for tempbans and bans.
